beats.idea: Purchasing power, gold backing and legal status questioned
beats.shows: Note–rice? Gold behind? Acceptance tick versus stamped law?
beats.template_note: First appear ₹100 note and rice with a question mark between them; on 'gold' appear gold beside the note with a question mark, not a backing arrow; on 'Payment' appear payment acceptance tick; on 'कानून' appear stamped law scroll beside it; on 'एक' compare the tick and scroll with '?'. No answer or confirmed exchange is shown.

beats.idea: Gold redemption then, not today's rupee
beats.relation_note: Contrast the hypothetical old bank's gold redemption with today's rupee; do not imply today's rupee is invalid.
beats.shows: Note enters bank; gold returns; modern redemption crossed.
beats.template_note: Show two labeled areas: hypothetical old bank and today's rupee. Hold: holder holds one note. At 'लौटाएँ', give the note from holder to teller. At 'लेकर', teller holds it. At '1 gram gold', give gold tagged '1 gram' from teller to holder. At 'आपके हाथ', holder holds gold. At 'आज का rupee', show today's rupee separately; at 'नहीं', cross only its gold-redemption arrow, not the rupee itself.

beats.idea: Value comes from gold redemption, not paper
beats.shows: Note redeems gold; receipt similarly points to goods.
beats.template_note: Appear note with a promise tag; on माँगने move note into an exchange position and reveal a fixed gold group. On Intrinsic reveal paper material with a low-value marker. Compare paper material with the note's gold promise; then compare receipt-to-goods and note-to-gold links.

beats.idea: Gold reserves alone do not establish a claim
beats.shows: Bank gold alone versus note-linked gold claim.
beats.template_note: Static comparison of conditions, not a redemption transaction: identical bank-and-gold slots, but only the second note has a claim link to gold. Mark the first condition insufficient and the second claim required.

beats.idea: Redemption promises explain backing for new notes
beats.shows: Redemption promise points to new notes requiring backing.
beats.template_note: Conceptual preview, not a note-issuance process. Show a promise seal pointing to new notes linked to gold backing; do not invent quantities or reserve ratios.

beats.idea: One more note needs one more gram
beats.relation_note: An additional gram of gold enables the eleventh fully backed note.
beats.shows: Ten gold–note pairs; extra gram enables eleventh note.
beats.template_note: appear bank; appear eleventh note beside question mark at '11वाँ'; at '10 grams' appear ten gold units inside bank, each tagged '1 gram'; at '10 notes' appear ten matching notes; at 'वादा' show '1 gram का वादा' on each note; at 'अगला' highlight eleventh note separately; at '1 gram और' appear additional gold unit with arrow to eleventh note, replacing question mark.

beats.idea: Gold reserves back the promise
beats.shows: Reserved gold linked to promise receipt
beats.template_note: Defines backing and reserves; no transaction occurs.

beats.idea: Gold-backed issue and qualified redemption
beats.shows: Bank issues notes; holder redeems for gold
beats.template_note: appear gold reserves inside central bank; give paper notes from official to holder on जारी; give notes back and give fixed gold to holder on देता; connect new notes to reserves on backing; show_text on redemption path: 'In principle; not unrestricted everywhere'. No numerical gold rate.

beats.idea: Lower repayment capacity undermines trust
beats.shows: Capacity falls; trust breaks; holders demand gold
beats.template_note: appear claims beside repayment capacity meter; meter down on घटे; transform intact trust indicator into broken indicator on टूटे; show_text gold-request bubbles on claim holders on माँगें, with gold pictured inside. Connect stages with arrows; do not show completed redemption.

beats.idea: Promise requires reserves that constrain issue
beats.shows: Promise → reserves → constrained notes; illustrative gram aside
beats.template_note: Conceptual recap, not a new transaction. Number the three linked stages; label the separate 1 gram illustration 'सिर्फ उदाहरण', never as a conversion rule.

beats.idea: Note issue carries redemption responsibility
beats.shows: Issued notes bound to redemption promise receipt
beats.template_note: Issue and redemption name an enduring obligation here, not a transaction to enact.

book_pictures.title: A horizontal line links four chronological dots
A horizontal timeline connects four dots from left to right

beats.idea: Receipts introduce distinct monetary milestones
beats.shows: Goods versus receipt; three milestone icons follow.
beats.template_note: A hypothetical substitution question, not a narrated transaction.

beats.idea: Deposit claims acquire a state issuer
beats.shows: Deposit-backed receipt precedes government-stamped Song note.
beats.template_note: appear deposited value and linked receipt at 'सबूत'; show_text receipt '7th century · Tang'; appear state note at '1023'; show_text note 'Song'; appear government issuer stamp beside note at 'सरकारी authority'. Use schematic documents, not invented historical facsimiles.

beats.idea: Compulsory acceptance predates Swedish banknotes
beats.shows: Refused note gains law stamp; China precedes Sweden.
beats.template_note: appear note and recipient; refuse note at 'मना'; appear stamped law scroll beside note at 'compulsory acceptance', replacing the hypothetical refusal with a compulsory-rule cue. At 'Sweden', appear Swedish banknotes with Sweden flag and 1661; compare China timeline milestones with Sweden to show chronological precedence.

beats.idea: Gold links differ from public redemption
beats.shows: Money–gold links; public gold counter crossed out.
beats.template_note: appear Britain money and gold linked under 1816; appear dollar and gold linked under 1944 Bretton Woods; show_text link 'official convertibility' at 'official convertibility'; appear public gold counter before 'हर व्यक्ति'; refuse counter at 'नहीं'. No quantities or universal redemption transaction.

beats.idea: Gold redemption ends at the shared endpoint
beats.shows: Gold-redemption link breaks; both timelines meet 1971.
beats.template_note: appear money and gold joined by a redemption link; refuse link at 'टूटा'; move both timeline endpoint highlights toward the shared 1971 marker. Keep gold itself uncrossed: redemption, not gold's existence, ends.

beats.idea: Why accept notes without gold redemption?
beats.shows: Cancelled gold promise; recipient questions the note.
beats.template_note: An unanswered conceptual question, not an actual acceptance or gold handover.

beats.idea: Monetary foundations change across the timelines
beats.shows: Claim, issuer, rules, gold-link milestones light successively.
beats.template_note: appear paper claim at 'Paper claims'; appear issuer stamp at 'issuer'; appear acceptance rule scroll at 'acceptance'; appear gold and its link at 'gold'; refuse redemption link at 'बदलता', recalling the already-established 1971 endpoint rather than suggesting every earlier change ended redemption.

beats.idea: Acceptance rests on onward spending trust
beats.shows: Rice exchanged; accepted note gains onward-spending thought bubble.
beats.template_note: appear ₹100 paper note at 'paper', with question mark; hold buyer's note at '₹100'; give note from buyer to shopkeeper at 'देकर'; give rice from shopkeeper to buyer at 'चावल'; accept note with shopkeeper at 'स्वीकार'; show_text on shopkeeper, bubble 'आगे खर्च कर पाऊँगा', at 'भरोसा'. No onward transaction is enacted because it is an expectation.

beats.idea: Fiat value rests on authority and trust
beats.shows: Authority, trust support note; note buys groceries.
beats.template_note: Appear authority seal and public trust symbol with arrows toward note value. At 'material से नहीं', show paper material with its proposed value-source arrow crossed out, not the note. At 'आज', buyer holds note; at 'कल groceries', buyer gives that note to grocer and grocer gives groceries to buyer. Use आज/कल tags, without invented amounts.

beats.idea: Paper form alone does not mean fiat
beats.shows: Gold-redeemable note differs from fiat paper note.
beats.template_note: Appear gold-backed paper note beside gold. At 'redemption', move that note inward and gold outward along opposite arrows to depict redemption. At 'हर paper note fiat नहीं', compare gold-backed paper note with fiat paper note using ≠; retain visible paper form on both.

beats.idea: Preview control of issuance without gold
beats.shows: Authority, trust above notes; issuance-control question remains.
beats.template_note: Static preview: authority and trust above currency notes; gold marked absent with 'बिना gold'; question mark beside notes labelled 'issue control?'. 'issue' and 'control' name a process whose mechanism is not explained in this beat.

book_pictures.title: Major Examples of Fiat Currency Today

beats.idea: Printing is not issuance; fiat rests on authority and trust
beats.shows: Printing versus issuance; authority and trust, not bullion
beats.template_note: appear printing press and notes beside issuance question mark; compare printing with issuance, sign ?; appear digital balance alongside notes; refuse gold-and-silver backing link at नहीं; appear government seal, central bank and public linked to fiat value.

beats.idea: Authorised circulation differs from printing and replacement
beats.shows: Printed notes enter circulation; replacement leaves total unchanged
beats.template_note: appear policy control over issuance; move new notes out of printing press at printing; appear authorisation stamp at authorised; move authorised notes into circulation; move old notes out and replacement notes in at बदलना; hold total money meter unchanged, without invented amounts.

beats.idea: Costlier credit can cool demand, with delays
beats.shows: Costlier loans slow expansion; demand eases after delay
beats.template_note: appear policy-rate and liquidity controls pointing to loan cost; meter loan cost upward at महँगा; hold expansion plan with shopkeeper and show pause at रोक; meter borrowing, spending and price pressure downward in an arrow chain marked possible; reverse direction for सस्ता credit; appear clock at समय; keep goods unchanged at नहीं बनाता.

beats.idea: Codes identify dollar and shared Euro currency
beats.shows: Price tags connect USD and EUR to places
beats.template_note: Static country-linked currency identifiers; reserve and trading icons accompany USD without numerical shares, while multiple EU country outlines share EUR.

beats.idea: JPY and CNY disambiguate the shared yen symbol
beats.shows: Shared ¥ splits into JPY and CNY
beats.template_note: appear shared ¥ with question mark; compare Japan–JPY and China–CNY beneath it; appear stability shield and currency-market icon beside JPY; meter CNY trade and reserve influence upward without numbers at बढ़; show reserve assets linked to external payments, not commodity backing.

beats.idea: Sterling’s old name does not imply uninterrupted fiat
beats.shows: Sterling timeline separates old roots from fiat status
beats.template_note: Static timeline from 8th century roots to today; historical gold-promise receipt prevents reading the whole timeline as continuously fiat.

beats.idea: Historical Euro adoption was twenty of twenty-seven
beats.shows: Twenty Euro badges among twenty-seven historical EU markers
beats.template_note: appear 27 neutral EU-member markers in a grid at 27; appear Euro badges on exactly 20 at 20; leave seven unbadged; show historical label and cross only the आज की updated गिनती tag at मत.

beats.idea: Descriptions cannot establish shares, stability or rankings
beats.shows: Unsupported share, stability and continuity inferences crossed out
beats.template_note: appear share chart with unknown values and flat exchange-rate line before crossing both at मत; appear old-name timeline with an uninterrupted-fiat overlay and refuse that overlay at नहीं; appear Euro podium with question mark beside measurement ruler at measure; invent no shares, rates or rank.

beats.idea: Reserves are not backing; excess demand erodes purchasing power
beats.shows: Money grows, goods stay; purchasing power can fall
beats.template_note: appear reserves and proposed backing link; refuse link at नहीं; grow money stack at ज़्यादा while goods stack stays fixed; compare demand above supply at आगे; meter purchasing power downward at घट with a possibility marker, not an inevitable-outcome claim.

beats.idea: Valid currency clears the entire debt
beats.shows: ₹100 changes hands; debt falls to zero.
beats.template_note: appear: debt balance ₹100 with a question mark; hold: customer holds ₹100 valid currency; give: customer to shopkeeper on ‘देते’; accept: shopkeeper accepts currency on ‘मानता’; meter: debt balance from ₹100 to ₹0 on ‘₹0’.

beats.idea: A special-design valid coin pays face value
beats.shows: One ₹10 coin buys one ₹10 item.
beats.template_note: appear: one distinctively patterned ₹10 coin, without inventing a named issue; hold: customer holds coin and seller holds an unspecified item tagged ₹10; give: coin from customer to seller on ‘देकर’; give: item from seller to customer on ‘लेते’; accept: tick on the paid ₹10 price on ‘चुक’.

beats.idea: Notes scale; coin acceptance has a limit
beats.shows: Notes settle bills; coin pile crosses acceptance limit.
beats.template_note: appear: ₹1,000 bill and two ₹500 notes; give: both notes from payer to recipient on ‘देते’; accept: paid bill. Reset for a separate ₹1,500 bill; appear: three ₹500 notes on ‘3’; give: three notes to recipient. Reset to coin payment; appear: 100 ₹10 coins in a ten-by-ten grid; meter: ₹0 to ₹1,000 with red limit line ₹1,000; give: the 100-coin group for the ₹1,000 bill. Reset to an alternative 101-coin offer, not an additional payment; appear: 100 coins plus one highlighted coin on ‘101’; meter: offered value ₹1,010 beyond the ₹1,000 line. show_text: recipient choice bubble ‘लेना मर्ज़ी’ on ‘मर्ज़ी’; leave the above-limit offer pending, without automatic refusal.

beats.idea: Official recognition and ordinary usability
beats.relation_note: Recognition applies within the government's territory; a second vignette shows commemorative coins used like ordinary coins.
beats.shows: Recognised money inside territory; both coin types usable.
beats.template_note: Appear: territory boundary, money and government recognition stamp inside. Move: money toward debt ledger and transaction receipt within boundary. On 'Circulation commemorative coins', appear: labelled commemorative and ordinary coin icons side by side; compare with equal usability tags. No specific coin design.

beats.idea: Valid banknotes have no total tender ceiling
beats.relation_note: An accumulating note stack has an open-ended amount meter, not a numerical count or capped meter.
nouns: Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 law scroll
beats.shows: Valid notes accumulate; amount meter has no ceiling.
beats.template_note: Appear: generic notes carrying denomination labels, with genuine and valid ticks. Appear repeatedly: notes join stack as meter grows, ending in an upward continuation arrow labelled 'No ceiling', without invented totals. Reveal each denomination on its spoken cue. Appear: stamped Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934 scroll beside notes on the Act's name.

beats.idea: Coin acceptance is compulsory only to a limit
beats.relation_note: A red line ends compulsory acceptance, not coin validity.
beats.shows: Coin pile reaches line; further acceptance becomes optional.
beats.template_note: Appear: coins accumulate while amount meter fills to red line labelled 'Prescribed limit'; stamp the compulsory-acceptance region. Above line show 'Acceptance voluntary', without crossing out coins. On 'Coinage Act, 2011', appear: named stamped law scroll beside coins. Stop compulsory-region fill on 'रुकती'.

beats.idea: Tender amount, circulation and validity are distinct
beats.relation_note: Three paired comparisons prevent three separate misconceptions.
beats.shows: Three comparisons separate ceiling, circulation and coin validity.
beats.template_note: Compare: banknotes tagged 'No tender ceiling' versus cash transaction receipt; cross only the claim 'हर cash transaction की छूट' on 'नहीं'. Compare: specially designed coin with circulation coins using a question mark, not an automatic circulation tick; show collector coin set separately on 'अलग'. Appear: coins above prescribed-limit meter line; retain validity tick on coins while crossing 'status खोना' on 'नहीं'.

beats.idea: After recognition, check denomination and total limit
beats.relation_note: Matched note and coin columns answer the total-limit question.
beats.shows: Recognised notes: no ceiling; recognised coins: fixed limit.
beats.template_note: Appear: recognition stamp above banknotes and coins. On 'denomination', reveal face-value tags without adding new denominations. On 'total limit', reveal matched amount meters. Notes meter ends with continuation arrow on 'ceiling नहीं'; coins meter stops at red 'Prescribed limit' line on 'तय'.

beats.idea: Legal tender need not always be fiat
beats.shows: Bitcoin counterexample crosses out universal fiat requirement
beats.template_note: Appear legal-tender and fiat tags with a question mark between them; at ‘सामान्य’ show their usual connection. At ‘गलत’ refuse the universal ‘must’ tag on that connection. At ‘Bitcoin’ appear its symbol as the counterexample, without crossing it out.

beats.idea: Commemorative coins have distinct status and values
beats.shows: Commemorative coins grouped by status; values separated
beats.template_note: Payment is a question about eligibility, not an enacted transaction. Show a fiat tag over the whole group, a larger legal-tender region and a smaller not-legal-tender region, without numerical proportions; keep metal and collector values as separate tags.

beats.idea: Collector condition explains rare everyday spending
beats.shows: Mint sets reach collector; protected coins rarely circulate
beats.image_wanted: Government Mint commemorative proof UNC coin sets packaging finish
beats.template_note: Appear packaged coins at ‘Pack’. At ‘बेचती’ move a collector set from Government Mint to the collector, labelled ‘बिक्री’, without inventing a price. Show proof finish close-up at ‘finish’ and UNC labelled ‘Uncirculated’ at ‘Uncirculated’. Retain sets in protective packaging at ‘condition’; at ‘कम’ show only a sparse path toward daily payments, not a refusal cross.

beats.idea: Invalid coins leave debt; valid coin clears it
beats.relation_note: Contrast two payments against the same ₹1 bill; cross rejected coins and tick the valid coin.
beats.shows: Old coins rejected; valid coin clears ₹1 balance.
beats.template_note: appear four old 25-paise coins beside ₹1 bill; show question mark at 'चुक जाएगा?'; hold coins toward shopkeeper; refuse coins at 'मना'; show outstanding ₹1 at 'बाकी'; give valid ₹1 coin from customer to shopkeeper at 'दें'; accept valid coin; meter outstanding from ₹1 to ₹0 at '₹0'; show_text 'Legal tender हटाया' on crossed old coins at 'demonetization'.

beats.idea: Different coin groups have different tender limits
beats.relation_note: Two separate capped meters; below-50-paise coins are crossed out rather than assigned a positive limit.
beats.shows: Coin groups fill capped meters; smaller coins crossed.
beats.template_note: appear change box with question mark at 'कौन-से'; appear each rupee denomination as named; group these beside one meter filling to red line ₹1,000 at '₹1,000'; appear 50-paise coins beside a separate meter filling to red line ₹10 at '₹10'; appear below-50-paise coins at 'छोटे'; refuse those coins at 'नहीं'. Do not depict a specific unstated coin count.

book_pictures.title: Current legal limits for coins (Coinage Act, 2011)

beats.idea: Coin count is not the monetary limit
beats.shows: Coin piles grow; separate counters and rupee meters.
beats.template_note: Appear 50 ₹20 coins while count rises to 50 and total-value meter reaches ₹1,000. At ‘नहीं’, cross a separate ‘1,000 coins’ interpretation, not the coins. Repeat with 20 fifty-paise coins, count 20 and total ₹10. Label denomination on each coin type and monetary limit on each meter's red line.

beats.idea: Different denominations have different tender rules
beats.shows: Coins separate; limit and status diverge; commemoratives questioned.
beats.template_note: Appear box, then move 50-paise and 25-paise coins into separate comparison slots. Place the Act scroll beside both; show ₹10 ceiling beside 50 paise. At ‘नहीं’, cross the 25-paise coin's legal-tender indicator. Then appear generic commemorative coins with ‘most ≠ all’ and a question mark beside their count; do not assign a numerical proportion or blanket status.

beats.idea: Amount and collector price do not determine status
beats.shows: Over-limit pile retains status; price cannot restore status.
beats.template_note: Use two independent panels. Move a coin pile's amount above a red limit line while its legal-tender status indicator remains unchanged. In the other panel, attach a collector-price tag to a coin with crossed legal-tender status; retain that cross at ‘लौटाती नहीं’. Supply no invented amounts or denominations.

beats.idea: Calculate total, then check limit and status
beats.shows: Denomination times count; total, limit, status checks follow.
beats.template_note: Appear denomination marker and coin counter separated by ×; connect to total-value display at ‘निकालिए’. At ‘फिर’, move the total marker beside the limit meter, then highlight the separate status indicator at ‘status’. Link both checks to the corresponding columns of the book table; add no numerical example.

beats.idea: Payment appearance does not establish government issuance
beats.shows: Bitcoin phone; issuance crossed; recognition shown separately
beats.template_note: Appear phone with Bitcoin payment; show question beside government issuance stamp; on 'नहीं' refuse that stamp only; on 'अलग' compare issuance stamp and legal recognition document in separate slots beside El Salvador’s flag.

beats.idea: Legal tender exception, but network-created Bitcoin
beats.shows: 2024 exception; mining creates; demand-supply determines price
beats.template_note: Appear 2024 marker with El Salvador flag, Bitcoin and legal-tender document tagged 'non-fiat exception'. On 'mining', appear linked mining computers and network rules; move newly appearing Bitcoin outward from the network. On 'demand-supply', show balance pointing to price indicator. On 'नहीं', refuse government fixed-value promise, not Bitcoin.

beats.idea: Compulsion ends; ownership and voluntary payment remain legal
beats.shows: Compulsion crossed; ownership checked; willing parties exchange Bitcoin
beats.template_note: Appear 2025 marker with compulsory acceptance law; on 'हटी' refuse the compulsory requirement only. On 'legal' accept owned Bitcoin. On 'दोनों राज़ी' show agreement ticks beside payer and recipient; then give Bitcoin payment from payer to recipient on 'payment'. Keep ownership and voluntary-use ticks visible through 'ban नहीं'.

beats.idea: Recognition changes do not change the issuer
beats.shows: Recognition changes; network stays; government-issuer stamp crossed
beats.template_note: Appear legal recognition document beside unchanged Bitcoin network. On 'बदलने' transform the document’s status mark while keeping network fixed. Show government issuer stamp beside network, then refuse that stamp on 'नहीं'.

beats.idea: Ask three independent classification questions
beats.shows: Three questions: issuer, ownership, voluntary versus compulsory
beats.template_note: A static three-slot question diagram: network with issuer question, owned Bitcoin with legality question, and handshake versus stamped law with acceptance question. No acceptance or payment process is asserted.

beats.idea: Same coin, two roles
beats.shows: Same ₹100 coin; payment versus collector’s question bubble
beats.template_note: Introduces contrasting roles, not a transaction sequence.

beats.idea: Face value differs from sale price
beats.shows: Identical coins: ₹100 versus कई हज़ार संभव
beats.template_note: Compares valuations without enacting a sale.

beats.idea: Collector premium leaves denomination unchanged
beats.shows: Silver, condition, collectability raise price; ₹100 stays
beats.template_note: Reveal coin’s silver surface, magnified condition detail and collector inspection; arrow these to a higher-price tag. Keep ₹100 unchanged. No exact premium is specified.

beats.idea: Collector price is not a payment rule
beats.shows: Collector price unequal to debt amount or limit
beats.template_note: Show two crossed equality signs, not refusal of the coin. Keep the law-stamped limit meter unnumbered; no counting or limit enforcement is narrated.

beats.idea: Use the value appropriate to the role
beats.shows: Payment coin: ₹100; collection coin: agreed price
beats.template_note: Recaps the two valuation roles without a transaction.

beats.idea: Written instruction pays fees from deposits
beats.shows: Instruction clears; deposit falls; insufficient funds leave fees unpaid.
beats.template_note: Write ₹1,000 on the instruction and move it to the bank. At Clearing, college receives ₹1,000 and payer balance falls from ₹2,000 to ₹1,000. At Funds कम, show a separate insufficient-funds branch: refuse the payment and leave the fee bill outstanding; do not invent a balance.

beats.idea: Issuer payment creates debt, not deposit spending
beats.shows: Issuer pays college; payer debt rises to ₹1,000.
beats.template_note: appear issuer payment; move payment to college at payment. Show the payer's repayment obligation to issuer as 0 at पहले; meter from 0 to ₹1,000 at अब. Tag obligation charges छोड़कर. At जमा पैसा नहीं, cross deposited money as the funding source; at credit, highlight the ₹1,000 obligation. Do not animate repayment: it is still owed.

beats.idea: Payment instruments are not currency or legal status
beats.relation_note: Parallel instrument-function rows; college acceptance is separated from legal classification.
beats.shows: Cheque instructs deposits; card accesses credit; acceptance ≠ status.
beats.template_note: Instruction, access and acceptance describe functions and classification here; no cheque clearing or card payment is narrated. Show cheque → deposits labelled instruction and card → credit labelled access; group both as payment instruments, distinct from currency. College acceptance gets a tick, but no implication arrow to fiat or legal-tender status.

beats.idea: Separate three questions; introduce dollar demand
beats.relation_note: Three distinct dimensions precede an unanswered question about dollar demand without gold backing.
beats.shows: Three separate symbols; unlinked gold–dollar, demand question mark.
beats.template_note: This is a conceptual recap and forward question, not a transaction. Keep value, status and method visually separate; at gold link show gold and dollar with a crossed connecting link, then a question mark beside dollar demand.
